notes.title: Kickstarter Campaign il live Now !
notes.content:
Hello friends,

I’m thrilled to announce that my Kickstarter campaign is now live!

There are some juicy rewards available—including the chance to shape the game’s vision by suggesting objects you’d like to see in it! Think of an item from your childhood that gives you chills… Now imagine experiencing that trauma in a real game—not bad, right?

Of course, there’s also the game key reward at a super fair price (discounted from the launch price). So if you want to help Condominium reach completion, jump in and become a backer! You’ll make this solo developer very happy. :)

Campaign link:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/matteolippera/condominium-story-driven-horr...

Bye for now,
Matteo
